title: Technical Business Developer Manager - Food / Ingredients
description:
**Roquette** 
 is a family\-owned global leader in plant\-based ingredients and a leading provider of pharmaceutical excipients.
   

  

**Want to help us make a difference?**
 Using plant\-based resources, we collaborate with our customers and partners to imagine and offer ingredients to better feed people and treat patients.
   

  

 Each of our ingredients responds to unique and essential needs, and they enable healthier lifestyles.
   

  

 To meet our challenges, we are looking for a
 **Technical Business Development Manager \- Food / Ingredients** 
 within the
 **Customer Technical Service** 
 (CTS) team!
   

  

 This position will be located in
 **Mumbai.**
**Purpose**
 The purpose of India Technical Business Developer Manager is to support Food Specialties products growth, especially starches and modified starches, leading the technical support and go\-to\-market strategy for India customers, driving mainly
 **Nutrition, Dairy, Baking (Snacks) and Seasoning** 
 segments business growth.
   

  

 Their mission ?
   

  

 The role creates, shapes, and accelerates demand for Roquette’s Food Specialties portfolio by combining deep technical expertise with strategic market development.
   

  

 The role drives segment growth based on sales strategy by:
   

  

* Building a robust sales funnel by identifying and developing new business opportunities (BOP),
* Leading technical concept creation and application development
* Strongly supporting together with the sales the conversion of the BOPs into wins
* Supporting customers with strong technical applicative know\-how and training, and
* Acting as the single point of contact for business development and technical engagement.


 This role bridges market needs from customers and technical solutions from Roquette, converting them into commercial wins through strong collaboration with Sales, CTS, Marketing, R\&D and regional customers.
   

  

**Your Experience And Talents Will Make The Difference To**
* Segment Strategy \& Market Development
* Identify market needs, create customers mapping fitting value proposition of Roquette solutions
* Build and execute the technical roadmap to generate valuable business opportunities in synergy with sales counterpart
* Application \& Concept Development
* Lead creation of application concepts with customers through recipe development, benchmarking, prototypes, and cost in use evaluation.
* Partner with Application Labs to run pilots, trials, validations, and scale ups.
* Build segment specific concept menus and run targeted application campaigns.
* Technical Customer Support
* Lead technical support and trainings for key regional customers.
* Provide technical recommendations, troubleshooting, and formulation guidance.
* Leverage CTS expertise with customer technical teams to accelerate project success.
* Opportunity Pipeline \& Funnel Management
* Build and maintain a strong and reliable business opportunity pipeline (BOP) based on segment ambition.
* Ensure opportunities are logged, documents, reviewed, updated and progressed into trials at customers and wins using SalesForce as management tool.
* Partner with AMs to support first commercial conversions.
* Customer Engagement \& Innovation Workshops
* Lead innovation workshops, customer co\-creation sessions, and technical showcases.
* Align trial protocols, value propositions, and technical data sheets.
* Internal Collaboration
* Collaborate with Marketing, CTS, Sales, and R\&D to deliver segment campaigns, samples, and trainings.
* Contribute technical insights to regional and global category teams.
* Market Intelligence \& Reporting
* Share trends, competitor activities, regulatory changes, and customer insights.
* Prepare quarterly segment intelligence updates.


**KPI**
* Pipeline (BOP), concept\-to\-trial\-to\-win conversion.
* Technical roadmap created, communicated, implemented and successful (BOP created)
* Innovation workshops delivered and validated concepts, generated BOPs
* Customer technical satisfaction and project cycle time improvement.
* Segment revenue/profitability contribution and trial success rates.


**What We Will Love About You**
* Strong knowledge of food ingredients (fibers, staches, modified starches, stabilizers, texturizers) and in the application areas of dairy, beverage, baking and snacks segments
* Proven experience delivering technical trainings and managing customer R\&D relationships.
* Strong business acumen, project pipeline management, and strategic thinking.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work cross‑functionally with CTS, Sales, Marketing, and customer technical teams
* Technical Applicative Competencies:
* Strong communication skills
* Delivers messages in a clear, compelling, and concise manner
* Actively listens and checks for understanding.
* Ability to effectively present information to groups and respond to questions from external counterpart.
* Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills e.g. delivering presentations.
* Understanding of ingredients and usage: interactions and processing 3\. Strong business acumen: understanding the food ingredients distribution market \& understanding the drivers for financial and business growth
* Functional Competencies: Segment mapping, market intelligence reporting, cross\-functional project leadership.


**And also …**
* Master’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering or related field
* 10–15 years experience in food product development, technical sales, or technical business development.


**Business travel:** 
 Domestic/international travel up to \~30%.
   

  

**If you identify yourself in this position, please apply by uploading your resume and let's start the journey together!**
 Roquette is proud to be a global company where you can find personal and professional growth through multiple diverse experiences.
   

  

 Roquette strives to create a dynamic workforce while remaining firmly committed to equal opportunity by complying with EEO laws.
   

  

 As we continue to grow, Roquette understands that to be successful we must always be inclusive in our approach.
   

  

 To find out more about our products, values and sustainable development ambitions visit us at www.roquette.com and at www.sustainability.roquette.com

title: Senior Salesforce Engineer
description:
**Some key info for you about Liberis:**
 🌱 We were founded in 2007
   

  

 💰 We have provided over $3bn of funding to small businesses so far
   

  

 🚀 We have been named in
 **CNBC \& Statista Top 150 UK Fintechs for 2025**
 🌍 We're a global team, with a dynamic presence in
 **6** 
 key locations around the world
   

  

 🧠 We're a thriving community of over
 **290** 
 innovative minds
   

  

 👩🏾 🤝 👨🏼 We're a vibrant melting pot, celebrating over
 **27** 
 nationalities in our team
   

  

 🏢 Our team brings experience from over
 **740** 
 previous companies, from startups to global giants
   

  

 🎯 We have just been named as one of
 **FinTech’s Finest 50** 
 by Welcome to the Jungle
   

  

 💪 We’re proud to be an accredited
 **Real Living Wage** 
 employer, ensuring everyone is paid fairly for the great work they do!
   

  

**Our Product \& Engineering Team:**
 Liberis is building the embedded finance platform that lets partners around the world offer innovative funding products to their small business customers. We're a growth\-stage fintech with teams in London, Nottingham, Atlanta, Stockholm, Munich and Mumbai, and we’re building a global Product, Data \& Engineering team that thrives on autonomy, ownership, and is focused on impact! Our teams solve real\-world problems for small businesses, shaping products that unlock opportunity at scale.
   

  

 Engineering is going through an AI\-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. It's changing what a small team can do! We empower our teams to make decisions, move fast, and take full responsibility for the solutions they deliver. You’ll join a team where curiosity is encouraged and collaboration across Product, Data, Delivery and Engineering is the norm.
   

  

 Our Salesforce Team:
   

  

 You’ll join the Salesforce engineering team within Liberis’ wider Technology function. The team owns and evolves the Salesforce platform that underpins how Liberis acquires, onboards, and supports merchants and partners across 15 markets. They also work closely with other engineering development teams, product teams, and business functions such as commercial and operations to turn business needs into reliable, well\-built Salesforce solutions.
   

  

 The role:
   

  

 As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you’ll take ownership of complex Salesforce solutions from discovery through to production. You’ll work across both code and configuration, making informed technical decisions around architecture, automation, integrations, security, and maintainability.
   

  

 You’ll be trusted to take ambiguous or complex requirements, work with stakeholders to understand the underlying problem, and shape a solution that is scalable and aligned with the wider Salesforce platform.
   

  

 You’ll remain hands\-on with Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, and declarative tooling, while also acting as a technical point of reference for other members of the team. You’ll review code and designs, support colleagues through challenging technical problems, and help improve the engineering practices that underpin how Salesforce changes are developed and released.
   

  

 Success in the role means consistently delivering high\-quality solutions with a high degree of autonomy, making sound technical decisions, and having a positive impact on both the platform and the engineers around you.
   

  

 What you’ll get to do:
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, and declarative tools such as Flow, validation rules, and Salesforce configuration.
* Own complex features and technical changes end to end, from understanding the business problem and shaping the technical approach through to testing, release, and production support.
* Make and contribute to technical design decisions across areas such as object modelling, automation, security and sharing, integrations, and platform architecture.
* Build and support integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and communicate them clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code and automated tests, and provide thoughtful code reviews that improve both the solution and the capability of the wider team.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, investigate root causes, and help improve platform resilience and observability.
* Work closely with Product, Commercial, Operations, and other engineering teams to challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure solutions address the underlying business need.
* Contribute to the evolution of engineering practices across the team, including Git\-based development, CI/CD, Salesforce DX, testing, release management, and documentation.
* Support and mentor other developers and admins, sharing knowledge and helping raise technical standards across the team.
* Proactively identify opportunities to simplify existing solutions, reduce technical debt, improve platform performance, and make Salesforce easier to maintain and evolve.
* Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision\-making so that knowledge is shared effectively across the team.


 What we think you’ll need:
   

  

* Proven success in a hands\-on Salesforce development role, with experience delivering and owning complex Salesforce solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, and SOQL/SOSL.
* Strong Salesforce configuration skills, including Flow, object modelling, validation rules, security, and sharing.
* Experience making or contributing meaningfully to technical design and architecture decisions, rather than only implementing predefined solutions.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, or similar integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of automated testing, code quality, and code review practices.
* Experience working with Git\-based version control and modern Salesforce development and deployment practices.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical or production issues.
* Strong communication skills, with experience working directly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand problems, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade\-offs clearly.
* A collaborative approach and experience supporting, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other developers.
* Good judgement around when to use code versus declarative Salesforce functionality, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and platform health.


**Next steps** 
 If this opportunity feels like the right fit for your next career move, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

 Even if you don’t meet every requirement, don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Chess (Internal Recruiter) on chess.crossley@liberis.com
   

  

 Career development is really important to us here at Liberis, with progression opportunities for both individual contributors and people managers. You can have a look through our Engineering Career Framework via this link
   

  

**Our hybrid approach**
 Working together in person helps us move faster, collaborate better, and build a great Liberis culture. Our hybrid working policy requires team members to be in the office at least 3 days a week. At Liberis, we embrace flexibility as a core part of our culture, while also valuing the importance of the time our teams spend together in the office.

title: Senior Developer, AI Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
 At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one\-of\-a\-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
   

  

 Join the EisnerAI team, a fast\-growing organization within EisnerAmper that is redefining how professional services harness the power of Artificial Intelligence. As an AI Engineer specializing in MLOps and AIOps, you will play a critical role in deploying, operating, and optimizing enterprise\-grade AI solutions built on Azure, collaborating closely with AI Developers, Product Owners, Governance leaders and Cloud Architects to ensure these systems are reliable, scalable, and cost\-effective across tax, audit, advisory, and client\-facing applications. This role goes beyond traditional DevOps—it’s about engineering AI into the fabric of enterprise operations, enabling secure, observable, and governed machine learning deployments that deliver real business impact.
   

  

**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**
* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work


**What Work You Will be Responsible For:**
* Deploy and monitor AI models across Azure services with robust telemetry for performance, drift, and availability.
* Manage model upgrades including APIs and UIs with structured rollout, version control, and rollback support.
* Optimize performance and cost through testing, profiling, and tuning of inference infrastructure and pipelines.
* Implement MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, deployment, and lifecycle management using Azure ML and GitHub Actions.
* Ensure compliant change management for all AI\-related deployments, with auditability, security, and governance controls.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field
* 3\+ years in MLOps and/or AIOps, ideally within Azure cloud environment with hands\-on experience with Azure ML, Synapse, Data Lake, App Services, Cosmos DB, and Azure AI Foundry


**Preferred/Desired Qualifications**
* Consulting background with a strong bias for action.
* Workflow Design: Prompt flow, automation pipelines, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems
* Post\-Training Techniques: Fine\-tuning, instruction tuning, RLHF, and domain adaptation
* Azure DevOps, App Insights, Log Analytics, Key Vault, and Managed Identity integration.
* Tools for inference performance testing and profiling (e.g., locust, K6, or custom scripts).
* Model Evaluation: Performance metrics, benchmark development, and A/B testing frameworks
* Understanding of model observability, telemetry, and incident response for AI systems.


**About EisnerAmper:**
 EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with approximately 450 partners and 5000 employees across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long\-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
   

  

 Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start\-ups, global public firms, and middle\-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not\-for\-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
   

  

**About EisnerAmper India:**
 EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non\-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
   

  

 EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007\. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 900 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.

 As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
   

  

**The opportunity** 
 : Senior Consultant\-FS\-Business Consulting Risk\-CNS \- RISK \- FSRM \- Mumbai
   

  

**FS :**
 Finance fuels our lives. Banking, Insurance and Wealth management, create the foundations for growth, prosperity and peace of mind. No other Industry touches so many people or shapes so many lives.
   

  

 Amid sweeping regulatory change, today’s financial services institutions are focusing on digital transformation, convergence and disruption from an array of nontraditional competitors — all while meeting greater demands for trust and transparency.
   

  

 To address this delicate balance of issues, our competent team of business strategists, technologists and industry leaders bring fresh thinking and sector knowledge across banking and capital markets, insurance, and wealth and asset management. The results are seamless collaboration, innovative problem solving, breakthrough performance gains and sustainable value creation.
   

  

 We recruit, train and nurture a diverse set of people who dedicate their minds to building the future of financial services. Together, we explore new perspectives with innovative and entrepreneurial thinking to deliver exceptional client service and ensure that what we do today, counts for tomorrow.
   

  

**CNS \- RISK \- FSRM :**
 EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client\-centric approach focuses on driving long\-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub\-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
   

  

 We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long\-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
   

  

 Enterprise Risk \- helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
   

  

 Technology Risk \- helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
   

  

 Financial Services Risk \- helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Java Spring Boot application development for building scalable and reliable business solutions. Proficient in developing responsive front\-end interfaces using React with integration to backend services and APIs. Solid understanding of cloud\-based application deployment and support on platforms such as GCP and AWS. Experience applying general consulting skills to translate business requirements into effective technical implementations. Ability to contribute to solution design, development, and troubleshooting in risk\-focused technology environments.


**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**
* Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science


**Experience**
* Full Stack Development (4\+ years)


**What We Look For**
 People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market\-leading growth over competitors. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group.  BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. title: Software Engineering - Executive Director - Parametric
description:
**About Morgan Stanley**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions, and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
   

  

**About Parametric**
 Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
   

  

 This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
   

  

**About Team**
 The Core Operations Platform is designed to build, integrate, and support a unified technology ecosystem that enables efficient, scalable, and controlled execution of Client and Market Operations processes.
   

  

 It serves as the central backbone for operational workflows, consolidating fragmented systems into a single, orchestrated platform that improves data integrity, reduces manual effort, and enhances operational transparency. This aligns with the broader vision of moving from multi\-system, manual processes to a unified, workflow\-driven model
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director, Software Engineering is responsible for providing technical leadership, project management, process development, training, support, and a technology vision for the Core Operation Platform. This team is responsible for multiple business processes namely Account Onboarding, Activities, Reconciliation and Reporting. The role will work with Data Services and Portfolio Management technology teams across the Direct Indexing business priorities, to design and develop technology solutions, and to improve business processes. This spans across core services to enable onboarding through our partners as well as business facing websites to allow the efficient onboarding and management of Accounts. These services will help streamline the rule\-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing allow for exception driven portfolio management.
   

  

 The Director will work closely with the Client Relationship Group and Market Operations for designing efficient applications to onboard accounts while minimizing risk. They will also work with the Digital Team developing services to that will be used by our Financial Advisor portal. In this role, the candidate will develop the appropriate software strategy, striking a balance between: (1\) alignment with the growth objectives of the Business; (2\) higher performance and consistently high quality; and (3\) cost effective application structure and use of new technologies.
   

  

 This leader will shape the long term product vision, drive engineering excellence, partner closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, intuitive user experiences across operational teams.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role accountable for setting direction, executing delivery, and building a high performing team that modernizes how users interact with operations platform and supporting data systems.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and execute the technology roadmap for the Core Operations Platform, aligning investments and capabilities with business priorities and long\-term growth objectives.
* Drive architecture and technology decisions that promote scalability, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to and help advance the AI and automation strategy for the Core Operations Platform, focusing on practical use cases that improve efficiency and decision\-making.


**Product \& Delivery Execution**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of technology solutions supporting account onboarding, operational workflows, reconciliation, reporting, and client servicing.
* Champion engineering best practices, including software quality, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


**Business Engagement \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Partner closely with Operations, Client Relationship Group, Digital, Data Services, and Portfolio Management Technology teams to identify and deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Translate business needs into technology strategies that improve user experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.


**People Leadership \& Organizational Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.


**Governance, Risk \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure technology solutions adhere to regulatory, security, and operational risk standards while maintaining platform stability and reliability.
* Establish strong governance, support, and change management practices that enable effective delivery and continuous operational improvement.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Asset management industry experience preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 7\+ years of Experience supervising and guiding software development teams and fostering an engaging, collaborative environment.
* 10\+ Years of Experience developing scalable solutions with advanced programming languages including .Net and Java framework.
* Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.
* Strong leadership skills including:
+ Vision and strategy
+ Influencing and consensus building
+ Communication
+ Total quality commitment
+ Ownership and accountability
+ Project management

* Successful track record of development and implementation of an innovative strategic vision and plans, and competence in building strategies to deliver technology to meet business goals and objectives. Ability to transform strategy into tactical plans and delivery.
* A creative, self\-confident self\-motivator with a "can do" orientation, along with the ability to function both independently and as a member of a team. Can work well in a fast paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Passionate, forward thinking and creative individual with high ethical standards and integrity.
* Ability to collaborate and partner as a business professional. The ability to facilitate, gain compromise and/or consensus within diverse teams.
* Assertiveness balanced with a sensitivity toward and concern for people. The ability to create strong work ethics and committed teams, foster open dialogue, and promote individual and team success.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills in customer and internal environment.
* Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation use cases to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.

title: AVP /VP - (Data Center Automation) - (Exp with Data Center Only)
description:
**ABOUT US** 




 BDx Data Centers is an AI\-ready digital infrastructure platform operating across Asia\-Pacific, with data centers in Singapore, Indonesia, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, and new markets in development. We deliver the powered, cooled, and connected capacity customers need to scale AI, cloud, hyperscale, and enterprise workloads across the region.

With 1\.2GVA\+ of secured grid capacity and a platform spanning campuses, hyperscale facilities, colocation, and edge infrastructure, BDx is built to support the next generation of digital growth.
 



  





 Backed by I Squared Capital, BDx is transformed for AI and proven at speed.
 



  





 For more information, visit www.bdxworld.com
 



  





  





 Assistant Vice President (Data Center Automation)
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 The Assistant Vice President of Data Center Automation is a senior leadership role responsible for driving the automation, optimization, and security of data center operations. This position oversees Building Management System (BMS) operations, and OSS/BSS (Operational Support Systems/Business Support Systems) functions, ensuring seamless integration, efficiency, and resilience across all systems. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, strategic vision, and proven experience in managing large\-scale data center and telecom/IT service environments.
 



  





 Technical Scope of Work
 



 System Architecture \& Design
 



 Define and document the overall control architecture, including:
 



 PLC/DDC network hierarchy and supervisory levels.
 



 OT LAN segmentation, VLAN design, and IP plan.
 



 Redundancy and failover logic for automation systems.
 



 Develop IO lists, control philosophy documents and functional design specifications (FDS).
 



 Coordinate between MEP consultants, controls contractors, and operations to align automation design.
 



 Control System Development \- Must
 



 Author control sequence logic for:
 



 Power systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of UPS, LV/MV switchgear, gensets, fuel systems, PDUs
 



  





 Cooling systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of chillers, CRAHs, pumps, valves, cooling towers, heat exchangers.
 



 Configure and validate PLCs, DDCs, and SCADA servers (Schneider / Siemens / Rockwell / Honeywell).
 



 Standardize data points and naming conventions across all systems.
 



 Implement interoperability via BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC\-UA, and MQTT brokers for telemetry aggregation
 



  





 Commissioning \& Validation
 



 Develop FAT/SAT scripts for validation of control logic, redundancy, and failover scenarios.
 



 Execute alarm and trend validation to ensure full functional coverage.
 



 Oversee integration testing with DCIM, AIops, or energy optimization platforms.
 



  





 OT \& Cybersecurity Governance
 



 Define the OT framework for automation systems, including:
 



 Network segregation between IT and OT.
 



 Firewall and DMZ policy enforcement.
 



 Patch management and backup strategy for controllers and servers.
 



 Align systems to IEC 62443 or equivalent cybersecurity compliance framework.
 



 Operations Enablement \- Must
 



 Create O\&M procedures for BMS / SCADA systems including:
 



 Change management and version control.
 



 Alarm rationalization and escalation protocols.
 



 Data historian configuration and retention policies.
 



 Develop automation analytics dashboards to track PUE, thermal KPIs, and predictive maintenance metrics.
 



 Maintain system access logs, firmware inventories, and security posture reports
 



 Continuous Optimization \- Must
 



 Collaborate with design and operations teams to:
 



 Tune PID loops and optimize control setpoints.
 



 Integrate AI models for predictive control.
 



 Support digital twin deployment and data validation
 



  





 Contract and Stakeholder Management
 



 Manage relationships with technology vendors, service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless operations and project execution.
 



 Negotiate contracts and oversee service\-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high standards of performance.
 



  





 At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.

**About the projects:** 
 we are building LLM evaluation and training datasets to train LLM to work on realistic software engineering problems. **About the Role:** 




 We are looking for experienced software engineers (tech lead level) who are familiar with high\-quality public GitHub repositories and can contribute to this project. This role involves hands\-on software engineering work, including development environment automation, issue triaging, and evaluating test coverage and quality
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




 Turing is one of the world’s fastest\-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. You’ll be at the forefront of evaluating how LLMs interact with real code, influencing the future of AI\-assisted software development. This is a unique opportunity to blend practical software engineering with AI research.
 



  





**What does day\-to\-day look like:** 



* Analyze and triage GitHub issues across trending open\-source libraries.
* Set up and configure code repositories, including Dockerization and environment setup.
* Evaluating unit test coverage and quality.
* Modify and run codebases locally to assess LLM performance in bug\-fixing scenarios.
* Collaborate with researchers to design and identify repositories and issues that are challenging for LLMs.
* Opportunities to lead a team of junior engineers to collaborate on projects.



  





**Required Skills:** 



* Minimum 3\+ years of overall experience
* Strong experience with at least one of the following languages: Python
* Proficiency with Git, Docker, and basic software pipeline setup.
* Ability to understand and navigate complex codebases.
* Comfortable running, modifying, and testing real\-world projects locally.
* Experience contributing to or evaluating open\-source projects is a plus.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Previous participation in LLM research or evaluation projects.
* Experience building or testing developer tools or automation agents.
* Perks of Freelancing With Turing:
* Work in a fully remote environment.
* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

title: SCT-Tech Enablement-Digital supply chain lead-FDE-Manager

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.

* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.

* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.

* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Solutions Architect - IIOT
description:
About the Role
 
  





 We are looking for an experienced IoT Solutions Architect with strong hands\-on background in Industrial IoT (IIoT) to design, architect, and lead end\-to\-end implementation of IoT solutions across manufacturing, energy, utilities, or other industrial environments. This role requires someone who has not just designed architectures on paper but has actually built, deployed, and supported IIoT solutions in real production/plant environments.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
  





 •       Design end\-to\-end IoT/IIoT architecture — from edge devices, sensors, and gateways to cloud platforms, data pipelines, and analytics/visualization layers.
 



 •       Lead technical implementation of IIoT projects including device connectivity (OPC\-UA, Modbus, MQTT, PROFINET, LoRaWAN), edge computing, and integration with SCADA/PLC/DCS/MES systems.
 



 •       Define data ingestion, storage, and processing architecture (time\-series DBs, stream processing, digital twin frameworks).
 



 •       Select and integrate appropriate IoT platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, GCP IoT, PTC ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, etc.) based on client/business needs.
 



 •       Own solution architecture from PoC to production rollout, including scalability, security, and reliability considerations.
 



 •       Collaborate with OT/IT teams to bridge industrial systems with enterprise IT and cloud infrastructure.
 



 •       Define and implement IoT security architecture — device authentication, data encryption, network segmentation (IT/OT security).
 



 •       Create technical documentation: architecture diagrams, solution blueprints, deployment guides, and SOPs.
 



 •       Work closely with sales/pre\-sales teams for solutioning, technical proposals, and client presentations.
 



 •       Design and deploy LoRaWAN\-based sensor networks, including gateway placement, network server configuration, and device provisioning.
 



 •       Troubleshoot and resolve architecture\-level issues during deployment and post\-production support.
 



  




 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  





 •       4–5 years in IoT/embedded systems/industrial automation, with hands\-on experience in IIoT solution architecture and implementation.
 



 •       Proven experience implementing (not just designing) IIoT solutions — device onboarding, edge deployment, cloud integration, dashboarding.
 



 •       Strong knowledge of industrial protocols: OPC\-UA, Modbus, MQTT, PROFINET, BACnet, etc.
 



 •       Hands\-on experience with LoRaWAN technologies — network architecture, gateway/end\-node deployment, network server platforms (e.g., The Things Stack, ChirpStack), and LoRaWAN device integration.
 



 •       Hands\-on experience with one or more IoT/cloud platforms: AWS IoT Core/Greengrass, Azure IoT Hub/Edge, GCP Cloud IoT, PTC ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, Litmus, or similar.
 



 •       Experience with edge computing devices/gateways (e.g., Dell Edge Gateways, Advantech, Siemens IoT2050, Raspberry Pi/industrial variants).
 



 •       Understanding of SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and OT network architecture.
 



 •       Experience with time\-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) and data visualization tools (Grafana, Power BI).
 



 •       Knowledge of containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) for edge/cloud deployments.
 



 •       Familiarity with IoT security best practices (device identity, PKI, network segmentation).
 



 •       Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Node.js, or similar) for automation and integration work.
 



 •       Experience working directly at customer/plant sites for deployment, commissioning, and troubleshooting is a strong plus.
 



  




 Preferred Qualifications
 
 •       Certifications such as AWS/Azure IoT specialty, CSSA, or relevant OT security certifications.
 



 •       Experience with digital twin implementations.
 



 •       Exposure to predictive maintenance / condition monitoring use cases.
 



 •       Prior experience in manufacturing, energy, utilities, or process industries.
 



  




 Education
 * •       B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or related field (M.Tech/MS preferred but not mandatory).

title: Quantitative Analyst HFT
description:
**Position: Quantitative Analyst \- HFT Desk (Neo Markets)**




  





**Role Overview:**




 We are seeking a highly skilled
 **Quantitative Analyst / Researcher** 
 to design, develop, and optimize
 **alpha\-generating trading strategies** 
 for our High\-Frequency (HFT) desk. The role requires deep expertise in
 **statistical modelling, market microstructure, and data\-driven research** 
 , with a strong focus on
 **low\-latency and high\-performance trading environments** 
 .
 



 You will work closely with traders, developers, and infrastructure teams to translate research ideas into production\-grade strategies.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:**




**Research \& Strategy Development** 



* Develop and implement systematic trading strategies across asset classes (equities, futures, options, etc.)
* Conduct alpha signal research using statistical techniques, machine learning, and time\-series analysis
* Analyze
 **market microstructure** 
 , order book dynamics, and execution signals to identify inefficiencies
* Perform hypothesis testing, back testing, and validation of trading strategies



**Data Analysis \& Modelling** 



* Work with large\-scale structured and unstructured datasets (tick\-level, order book data)
* Build predictive models for price movement, liquidity, and volatility
* Apply advanced techniques such as Time\-series modeling, Stochastic processes, Optimization methods and Machine learning (supervised/unsupervised)



**Back\-testing \& Simulation** 



* Design robust
 **back testing frameworks** 
 with realistic assumptions (latency, slippage, fees)
* Evaluate performance using metrics like Sharpe ratio, Calmar Ratio, drawdown, hit rate, and PnL attribution
* Conduct parameter optimization and stress testing



**Collaboration \& Productionization** 



* Work closely with
 **low\-latency developers** 
 to deploy strategies into production
* Monitor live strategies and refine models based on real\-time feedback



  





**Key Skills \& Experience:**




**Education** 



* Bachelor’s / Master’s / PhD in:
* Mathematics
 **,** 
 Statistics
 **,** 
 Computer Science
 **,** 
 Physics
 **,** 
 Engineering or related quantitative field



**Technical Skills** 



* Strong programming skills in
 **Python (mandatory)** 
 , C\+\+ (preferred)
* Experience with NumPy, Pandas, SciPy. Data handling \& large dataset processing
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix systems, Version control (Git).



**Quantitative Skills** 



* Solid understanding of Probability \& statistics, Linear algebra and optimization and Time\-series analysis
* Knowledge of Market microstructure, Order book dynamics and Execution algorithms



**Trading Knowledge** 



* Understanding of Equity / derivatives markets and Exchange mechanisms (NSE, BSE, global markets preferred)
* Experience with
 **HFT/MFT strategies** 
 is highly desirable



  





**Preferred Qualifications:**



* Prior experience in Proprietary trading firms / hedge funds / HFT firms
* Exposure to Low\-latency systems and event\-driven architectures
* Experience with trading strategies in production and having PnL responsibilities
* Participation in Competitive programming / Kaggle / quant competitions



  





**About Neo Group:**




 Neo Wealth and Asset Management is a rapidly growing financial services company with businesses spanning wealth management, asset management, capital markets and lending. Founded in 2021 with a simple and enduring purpose,
 **Do Good** 
 , Neo is building a modern financial institution from India, with global aspirations.
 



 Today, Neo manages and advises on over ₹1\.3 lakh crore in client assets, serves clients across more than 200 locations, and is powered by a team of over 850 professionals. Its expanding presence includes India and the United States, with Dubai planned as the next step in its international growth.
 



 Neo is backed by leading global and Indian institutional investors, including Peak XV Partners, MUFG Bank, Euclidean Capital, and TVS Capital Funds, and has raised more than ₹3,000 crore in capital, making it a unicorn. Its growth has been driven by deep investment expertise, strong client relationships, and a culture that values ownership, integrity and long\-term thinking.
 



 At Neo, people have the opportunity to help build an institution, not merely work within one.

title: AI-Native Developer
description:
**Company Description** 




 Indexed builds innovative SEO systems designed for the future of search. We partner with ambitious brands to deliver full\-stack SEO solutions, supported by high\-performance design, development, and strategic insights. Trusted by global clients, Indexed has driven millions in revenue, clicks, and conversions, along with top\-ranking results in highly competitive markets. We create scalable, enduring growth systems for enterprise brands across the US, UK, and Europe.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We're looking for an AI\-Native Developer — a full\-stack web developer who builds primarily through modern AI coding tools like Claude Code, GPT Codex, and Cursor, and uses them to genuinely multiply output rather than as a novelty. Half of your time will go into building internal tools and systems that scale Indexed itself; the other half will go into building for our clients, many of whom run on WordPress.
 



 You'll set the technical approach for what you build, move fast across multiple projects at once, and be trusted to take a rough idea from a non\-technical teammate and turn it into a working tool in days, not weeks. You should be as comfortable explaining a technical decision to a client or a non\-developer colleague as you are writing the code itself.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**Build, fast, with AI as your leverage** 



* Use Claude Code, GPT Codex, Cursor, and similar tools as your primary way of building — full\-stack, from front end to back end
* Build internal tools and systems for Indexed that scale delivery, reporting, and operations across the agency
* Build and ship work directly for clients, including WordPress sites and custom builds, on the same fast timeline
* Work across multiple builds at once — internal and client\-facing — without dropping quality or pace



  





**Own the pipeline** 



* Have full proficiency with GitHub and pipeline deployment — branching, review, CI/CD, releases
* Set the technical approach for new tools and builds, rather than waiting to be handed a spec
* Make the calls on what to build, how, and in what order to hit Indexed's build ambitions



  





**Translate for non\-developers** 



* Explain technical decisions, trade\-offs, and timelines clearly to non\-technical teammates and clients
* Turn a loosely defined idea from someone outside engineering into a scoped, buildable plan



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Full\-stack development skills, with genuine, daily hands\-on use of AI coding tools like Claude Code, GPT Codex, and Cursor
* Solid WordPress experience — a large share of our clients run on it
* Full proficiency with GitHub and pipeline deployment
* A portfolio of tools or websites you've actually built using AI coding tools — you'll need to walk us through it
* Agency experience is a strong plus
* Good English, and the ability to explain technical work clearly to non\-developers and clients
* A strong work ethic — this role moves fast and covers a lot of ground
* Comfortable working on multiple projects (internal and client\-facing) at the same time
* 3\+ years of experience, including meaningful experience building with AI tools



  





**What You'll Get** 



* Competitive pay based on experience
* Real ownership of how Indexed builds — internal tools and client work alike
* Direct access to leadership, with no layers of approval slowing you down
* A front\-row seat to scaling an agency's build capacity with AI\-native tooling



  





**How to Apply** 




 Two steps. You need to do both to be shortlisted.
 



**1\. Apply through LinkedIn.** 




**2\. Email careers@joinindexed.com** 
 with the subject line AI\-Native Developer — \[Your Name], and include:
 


* Your CV
* **A portfolio of tools or sites you've built using AI coding tools** 
 (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) — link to them and tell us what you built and how.
* **An example of a WordPress build or a GitHub/CI\-CD pipeline you've owned** 
 .



 Applications without the email will not be reviewed. Show us what you've actually built — that matters far more than a list of tools you know.

title: Software Engineer - Java
description:
We are seeking a driven Java engineer to join our global research platform team in Mumbai. The team builds and operates the compute and data platform that powers all of IMC's quantitative research: a large\-scale Kubernetes\-based research cluster, a distributed job scheduling platform used by every trading and research team, and the market\-data and dataset services that feed research on it. Mumbai runs one of the platform's regional production deployments, and you'll collaborate closely with platform colleagues in Amsterdam, Chicago and Sydney.
   

  

**Your Core Responsibilities**
* Design, build and operate the Java backend of our distributed job scheduling platform: the job controller and state machine, scheduling integrations, resource and cost tracking, and the failure\-recovery machinery that keeps research workloads running at scale
* Develop gRPC/protobuf APIs consumed by Python, Java and C\+\+ clients across the firm
* Build event\-driven services on Kafka for job lifecycle tracking, data lineage, and dataset orchestration
* Work hands\-on with Kubernetes at scale: pod scheduling, fair\-share queueing, preemption and multi\-cluster placement
* Instrument, monitor and firefight production systems, and drive root\-cause analysis of performance bottlenecks
* Support and consult research users in the India office


**Your Skills And Experience**
* 3\+ years of professional Java development experience (Java 17\+, Maven/Gradle, strong grasp of concurrency and JVM performance)
* 2\+ year of hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker (building on the K8s API is a strong plus)
* Comfortable developing in Python; our client libraries and research users are Python\-first, and you'll work on both sides of the API
* Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals: state machines, retries/idempotency, event\-driven architectures, consistency trade\-offs
* Experience with workload scheduling or batch/compute orchestration systems (e.g. Kubernetes schedulers, Slurm, YARN, Kueue, Ray, Airflow)
* Experience with messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka
* Working knowledge of NoSQL and time\-series/SQL databases (e.g. MongoDB, PostgreSQL)
* Experience with gRPC/protobuf or similar RPC frameworks is a plus
* Strong Linux fundamentals and scripting (bash, Python)
* Experience with monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, alerting) and comfort operating what you build
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across the stack from application code through Kubernetes to network and storage
* Exposure to object storage (S3\) or high\-performance data formats (Parquet, Iceberg)


**About Us**
*IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: Lead Software Engineer : Vice President
description:
We’re seeking someone to join our FORT Tech team as a Vice President \-Java \& Cloud Engineering, in Operations Technology.
   

  

**Operations Technology** 
 develops and maintains systems in support of Morgan Stanley's global Operations , including (but not limited to) Settlements, Confirmations, Regulatory Reporting, Position Keeping, Corporate Actions processing and other post\-trade functions. Operations Technology is a global organization that is client\-focused and functionally aligned. Our organization is built to support our clients functional, regional and business\-facing requirements while delivering innovative technology and ensuring plant and processing stability. The Firm operates at scale with up to 40 million trades processed on peak volume days and hundreds of billions of dollars of daily settlements with activity ongoing in multiple countries and currencies across the globe. There is a great breadth of financial products that our Operations plant handles across equity and fixed income, from cash products to complex derivatives and loans.
   

  

 In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities.
   

  

 This is Vice President position that develops and maintains software solutions that support business needs.
   

  

 Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
**Technology Leadership**
* Define and drive the strategic technology roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Lead architecture and design decisions for distributed, event\-driven, cloud\-native platforms.
* Establish engineering standards, architectural principles, and development best practices.
* Drive modernization initiatives, platform transformations, and cloud adoption strategies.
* Champion non\-functional requirements including scalability, resiliency, performance, observability, and security.
* Ensure architecture decisions support future business growth and operational efficiency.


**Delivery \& Execution Leadership**
* Lead multiple Agile squads and engineering teams across geographies.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of strategic programs, ensuring quality, predictability, and timely execution.
* Drive planning, prioritization, dependency management, and execution across multiple workstreams.
* Manage risks, impediments, and delivery challenges while maintaining alignment with business priorities.
* Partner with Product, Operations, QA, DevOps, Architecture, and Business stakeholders to deliver functional objectives.
* Establish and monitor engineering metrics, operational KPIs, and service health indicators.


**People Leadership**
* Build, mentor, and develop high\-performing engineering teams.
* Provide career guidance, coaching, and technical mentorship to Directors, Managers, and Senior Engineers.
* Lead performance management, succession planning, talent reviews, and workforce planning.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, diversity, inclusion, and continuous learning.
* Attract, retain, and grow top engineering talent.
* Develop future technology leaders within the organization.


**Stakeholder \& Organizational Leadership**
* Serve as a trusted technology partner to senior business and technology leaders.
* Influence investment decisions and technology strategy through data\-driven recommendations.
* Communicate technology vision, execution status, risks, and opportunities to executive stakeholders.
* Drive cross\-organizational collaboration and alignment across multiple teams and functions.
* Balance short\-term delivery commitments with long\-term strategic goals.


**Risk, Controls \& Governance**
* Ensure compliance with enterprise technology standards, security policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Drive operational excellence, production stability, and resiliency improvements.
* Establish governance processes for architecture reviews, engineering quality, and SDLC controls.
* Lead incident management reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
**Leadership \& Management**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience leading large engineering organizations.


 At least 8 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role .
   

  

* Proven track record managing multiple engineering teams or Agile squads delivering complex enterprise platforms.
* Demonstrated success in driving large\-scale transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Strong people leadership experience including coaching, career development, succession planning, and organizational growth.
* Experience managing geographically distributed teams and stakeholders.


**Core Technology**
* Deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and the Spring ecosystem.
* Extensive experience designing and implementing microservices architectures.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, domain\-driven design, and event\-driven architectures.
* Experience building high\-volume, low\-latency, mission\-critical systems.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, design patterns, and architectural principles.


**Cloud Platforms \& Engineering**
* Strong expertise in Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud platforms.
* Experience designing and operating cloud\-native applications at enterprise scale.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containerization, orchestration, and platform engineering.
* Experience building highly available, fault\-tolerant, and scalable cloud solutions.
* Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code and cloud automation frameworks.


**Middleware \& Event Streaming**
* Expertise in event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Kafka, MQ, Event Hubs, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong experience integrating distributed services through APIs and asynchronous communication patterns.
* Experience designing resilient, high\-throughput integration architectures.


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

 Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar databases.

 Strong understanding of Git and Git\-based development workflows.
   

  

 Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
   

  

 Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP.
   

  

 Understanding of application monitoring, logging, and deployment practices.
   

  

 Good to Have
   

  

 Strong TypeScript experience across frontend and backend.
   

  

 Experience with Next.js.
   

  

 Experience integrating LLM/Generative AI APIs into applications.
   

  

 Familiarity with AI concepts such as LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, vector databases, and AI agents.
   

  

**Experience With OpenAI, Anthropic, Or Other LLM APIs.**
 Knowledge of Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies.
   

  

 Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
   

  

 Understanding of system design and scalable architecture.
   

  

 Exposure to GraphQL.
   

  

 Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
   

  

 6–7 years of professional software development experience.
   

  

 Strong hands\-on expertise in React.js and Node.js.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability to use AI\-assisted development tools effectively and responsibly.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
   

  

 Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
   

  

 Ability to independently own features and deliver production\-quality solutions.
   

  

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on Senior Full Stack Developer who can work across the React.js frontend and Node.js backend and leverage modern AI tools to improve development efficiency.
   

  

 We are particularly interested in candidates who combine strong software engineering fundamentals with AI fluency—using tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot as productivity multipliers while retaining ownership of architecture, code quality, security, testing, and technical decisions.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
